meta.title: Closed forms and single values used by the PSC validation cases (valve face-to-face, gaskets, plain-end mass, B31.3 pressure wall, EN 10220 diameters, scopes)

massFormula.formula: m [kg/m] = 0.0246615 * (D - t) * t, D = outside diameter mm, t = nominal wall mm (plain-end steel, density 7850 kg/m3: pi * 7850e-6 = 0.02466150)

sources.S16: Ferrostaal piping supply catalogue (slideshare extract): 'Wpe = 0.0246615 (D - t) * t' for ASME B36.10 pipe
sources.S17: Steel & Tube (NZ) piping systems data charts 2013: 'm = (D - t) t x 0.02466', https://steelandtube.co.nz/sites/default/files/catalogues/S%26T_piping_systems_data_charts_2013_bm2_0.pdf

b313PressureWall.formula: t = P D / (2 (S E W + P Y)) (ASME B31.3 para. 304.1.2 eq. 3a, valid t < D/6); tm = t + c; nominal >= tm / (1 - 0.125) for a 12.5 % minus mill tolerance

sources.S18: whatispiping.com 'Pipe thickness calculation per ASME B31.3' worked example (NPS 4, 1200 psig, S 19000 psi, E = W = 1, Y = 0.4, c = 3 mm: t 3.52, tc 6.52, 7.45 mm after mill tolerance)
sources.S19: epcland.com B31.3 pressure design articles (equation and Y = 0.4 for ferritic steel below 482 C); Eng-Tips Interpretation 2-11 thread (t excludes mill tolerance and c)

b313PressureWall.grade: A (closed form, two sources, worked example recomputed)

selectedSchedule.answer: Sch 80 (8.56 mm): smallest B36.10M schedule with wall >= 7.452 mm (Sch 40 6.02 fails; XS 8.56 equal)

b313PressureWall.note: S, E, W, Y and c are inputs given explicitly by the spec or the operator (AF-31): llull ships no allowable-stress table in the MVP.

valveFaceToFace.standard: ASME B16.10, Class 150 flanged raised-face gate valves (short pattern)

sources.S20: Project Materials 'ASME B16.10 face to face overview', https://blog.projectmaterials.com/quick-answers/valves/asme-b16-10-face-to-face-overview/ (search extract)
sources.S21: Wermac 'Face to Face dimensions of flanged valves', https://wermac.org/valves/dim_valves_ff.html (search extract)

spiralWoundGasket.standard: ASME B16.20 spiral-wound gasket for ASME B16.5 raised-face flanges

sources.S22: Wermac 'Spiral wound gaskets ASME B16.20' table, https://www.wermac.org/gaskets/dim_gaskets_sw.html (search extract: NPS 4 inner ring 106.4, sealing element OD 149.4, Class 150 outer ring 174.8)
sources.S23: Garlock product page, Class 150 NPS 4 spiral wound gasket, inner ring ID 106.43 mm (search extract), https://www.garlock.com/product/l00051004001
sources.S24: Second class-150 table (search extract): NPS 4 outer ring 174.8 mm, Class 300 181.1 mm

sources.S26: Sikla 'Rohre (Abmessungen und Gewichte)' DIN EN 10220 welded tube table (search extract lists 21.3..139.7)
sources.S27: Project Materials 'EU pipe sizes EN 10220 & EN ISO 1127' (search extract)

en10220Diameters.note: EN 10220 26.9 / 33.7 / 42.4 / 76.1 / 139.7 differ from ASME B36.10M 26.7 / 33.4 / 42.2 / 73.0 / 141.3 for the same DN: a spec must name its dimensional standard.

scopes.B36.10M: NPS 1/8 .. 80, carbon / alloy / ferritic stainless wrought steel pipe (projectmaterials 'What is ASME B36.10', SAI Global catalogue)
scopes.B36.19M: stainless pipe, schedules 5S/10S/40S/80S (tubingchina comparison; SFS store page)
scopes.B16.47: large-diameter flanges NPS 26 .. 60, Series A and B (flange-studbolt-finder dataset meta; Wikipedia 'Flange')
